result_free_lock.permitted_design_input: Only the disclosed S-071 aggregate failure mechanism informed the prospective estimator choice; no S-071 value, sample, path, bootstrap draw, estimate, or interval is embedded in or read by production.
result_free_lock.mutation_rule: Any semantic change requires a new plan version and a fresh independent V-072 review before execution.

prior_attempt_boundary.production_rule: Never open these paths from the S-072 runner; never pool, retry, top up, overwrite, rename, or promote them.

scope.evidence_role: Fresh finite-parameter conditional-moment hybrid Monte Carlo support for accepted exact theory.
scope.claim_boundary: Trajectory evidence may support the preregistered finite active case and named headline contrasts; it does not prove continuum-wide formulas, exact protocol equivalence, novelty, a higher-order result, or any unlisted limit.
excluded_work: S-071 retry, top-up, pooling, overwrite, or alternate output
production pilot or stochastic probe during S-072
post hoc count, tier, margin, window, estimator, or tolerance change
claim that shared multilevel seeds constitute an independent method route

locked_model.event_semantics: Sample exponential reset times exactly, integrate to each event by splitting the current step, record the pre-reset state, apply the fixed map without advancing time, then continue from the post-reset state.

independence.method_family: Conditional-moment hybrid Monte Carlo: exact-clock reset and rotational Brownian paths, independently derived translational conditional transitions, and coupled three-level weak-error extrapolation.
independence.stochastic_dimension_analytically_margin: Translational Wiener noise is integrated exactly in conditional first and second moments and is never instantiated by an RNG.
forbidden_trajectory_kernel_imports: any moment operator or moment ODE
any S-071 raw or derived result artifact
independence.analytic_reference_layer: experiments/s070_reference_adapter.py, loaded only after all conditional trajectory summaries, hashes, Richardson inputs, and uncertainty inputs are frozen.
independence.disclosure: The replacement shares the approved contract, parameters, protocol names, reference adapter, exact-clock concept, classification utilities, and S-070 event semantics. It does not claim that fresh or multilevel seeds alone create method independence; the material method change is conditional translational integration plus three-level Richardson.

source_authentication.manifest_policy: Authenticate Contract Section 7, registry/schema/validator, the plan, adapter, runner, tests, pyproject, pinned runtime requirements, and every Python source file under src/phasemap.
source_authentication.reviewed_source_commit_binding: The V-072 marker binds the newest commit touching any manifest path; production requires that commit to be an ancestor of the clean execution HEAD with no manifest-path diff.

parameter_cases.purpose: All-seven finite active case for the minimal spatial classifier, internal-sector identities, drift, contracted-observation degeneracy, and separating spatial witness.

numerical_schedule.orientation_quadrature: left endpoint at each level; fixed first-order weak discretization target
numerical_schedule.translational_update: exact constant-orientation conditional mean and covariance transition on every exact-clock segment
numerical_schedule.coupling_rule: Middle rotational increments sum two finest increments and coarse increments sum four; every level shares exact reset clocks and flushes at each reset before the fixed map.
numerical_schedule.B_disc: max(abs(lower),abs(upper)) for the matched interval of (primary-minus-secondary Richardson estimates)/3

sampling.fixed_count_rule: Run exactly the declared fresh count once. Any unresolved or failed adequacy diagnostic stops S-073 without added units, retry, or alternate output.

seed_policy.translational_component_status: Component 2 is reserved and analytically marginalized; production must instantiate no component-2 RNG.
seed_policy.main_protocol_coupling: All seven main protocols use the same 32 reset/rotation tuples for disclosed common random numbers.
seed_policy.unpaired_rule: Each required protocol uses a distinct base seed and therefore an independent reset/rotation domain.
seed_policy.clean_room_rule: Reserved only; not used by S-073 and not evidence of route independence.
seed_policy.disjointness_proof: Every enumerated S-072 production/bootstrap tuple has first coordinate in the 7207... namespace; every S-071 stochastic/bootstrap/reserved domain has first coordinate in the listed 7007... namespace. Tuple equality is therefore impossible. Within S-072, unpaired protocols have distinct first coordinates.

stationary_internal_observables.estimator: For each trajectory, average mean_squared_speed over the primary late window; then use the trajectory mean. H3 separately hashes every recorded v and theta value for its three pathwise internal-sector checks.
stationary_internal_observables.uncertainty: trajectory-level sample standard error with the declared tier quantile

observables: stationary centered spatial covariance trace for P, PV, PTheta, and PVTheta
raw mean_squared_displacement for the PV/PVTheta H4 contrast only
mean_position_dot_velocity for the PV/PVTheta H4 contrast only
localized_spatial_observables.estimator: Average the ensemble statistic over the primary late window, treating complete trajectories as independent units.
localized_spatial_observables.uncertainty: whole-trajectory bootstrap-SE normal-equivalent interval with fixed replicate-block stability diagnostic

transport_observables.estimator: Mean velocity is a late-window trajectory mean. D_eff is one quarter of the least-squares slope of the ensemble centered covariance trace in the primary window.
transport_observables.uncertainty: D_eff uses a whole-trajectory bootstrap estimate of the standard error and the fixed tier normal-equivalent quantile; naive repeated-time OLS standard errors are prohibited.

observable_and_estimator_plan.rao_blackwellization: For each reset/rotation path and level, propagate conditional E[r], E[v], Var(r_x)=Var(r_y), Cov(r_x,v_x)=Cov(r_y,v_y), and Var(v_x)=Var(v_y). Form E[|r|^2], E[|v|^2], and E[r dot v] by total expectation. Centered covariance uses mean conditional variance plus unbiased between-conditional-mean covariance.
observable_and_estimator_plan.richardson: Form each scalar unit as 2*Y_h2-Y_h. For nonlinear centered-variance and D_eff estimands, recompute each level from sufficient features inside every whole-unit bootstrap replicate, then extrapolate the resulting estimands. The secondary 2*Y_h-Y_2h is never pooled into the primary estimate.
observable_and_estimator_plan.statistical_unit: One independent reset-clock plus rotational-Wiener conditional path; translational Wiener noise is analytically averaged, not counted as extra samples.
observable_and_estimator_plan.bias_control: B_window uses the unchanged three late windows on the primary Richardson estimator. B_disc is the full matched interval envelope of (primary-minus-secondary Richardson estimates)/3, the first-order Richardson residual-error estimate. Both remain separate from Monte Carlo SE.

late_time_windows.B_window: max over the two nonprimary admissible windows of abs(estimate_window-estimate_primary)

bootstrap_se_stability.failure_outcome: unresolved unless another required check is contradicted

uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.bootstrap_replicate_justification: The interval uses the tier's fixed analytic normal-equivalent quantile and bootstrap only to estimate the whole-trajectory standard error, so no empirical 99% or 99.73% tail quantile is estimated. With 2048 fixed replicates, the idealized relative Monte Carlo standard error of a standard-deviation estimate is approximately 1/sqrt(2*(2048-1)) = 0.01563. Four fixed 512-replicate blocks must each yield an SE within 10% of the full-replicate SE; failure is unresolved and does not authorize more replicates.
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.bootstrap_unit: complete matched trajectory for paired calculations; complete independent trajectory for direct calculations
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.bootstrap_algorithm: For each exact multinomial trajectory resample, use count weights on per-trajectory (r_x,r_y,|r|^2) values at every recorded time. Recompute the ensemble means and centered covariance curve exactly from those weighted sufficient features, then recompute the declared window statistic. Fine/coarse pairs use the same weights. Process at most eight resamples at once; never copy a full (time,N,2) array per replicate.
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.D_eff_interval: two-sided whole-trajectory bootstrap-SE interval using the fixed tier normal-equivalent quantile
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.stationary_variance_interval: two-sided whole-trajectory bootstrap-SE interval using the fixed tier normal-equivalent quantile
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.B_disc: For each target, compute the paired (primary-minus-secondary Richardson)/3 estimate and its matched interval. Use max(abs(lower),abs(upper)) as the nonnegative discretization envelope.
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.separation: Monte Carlo uncertainty, B_window, and B_disc are recorded separately and are never pooled into one standard error.

variance_reduction_adequacy.purpose: Prospective fail-closed check that the revised estimator has enough precision; it cannot relax a registry comparison.
variance_reduction_adequacy.formula: Require q*SE <= 0.50*epsilon and q*SE+B_window+B_disc <= 0.75*epsilon for every stochastic comparison.
variance_reduction_adequacy.failure_outcome: unresolved even if the ordinary registry interval would otherwise validate; no added units, bootstrap replicates, polling, retry, top-up, or threshold change.
variance_reduction_adequacy.analytic_invariant: Every late-time conditional translational covariance used by a retained nontrivial translational observable must be finite and nonnegative; component-2 RNG use or a failed total-variance identity is contradicted.

headline_comparisons.target: Position-reset protocols validate finite stationary centered variance; non-position protocols validate finite positive centered D_eff.
Validate each late mean velocity against its accepted analytic reference and validate the nonzero Theta-minus-V and VTheta-minus-V x-drift contrasts.
headline_comparisons.unpaired_confirmation: Recompute the two named drift differences from smaller protocol-independent streams using independent-sample uncertainty.

headline_comparisons.target: With shared clocks and Wiener paths, every recorded v and theta value must agree pathwise within 1e-12; selected nonzero internal moments are also compared to the common analytic reference.
headline_comparisons.unpaired_confirmation: On distinct protocol streams, compute each same-estimand speed difference with independent-sample uncertainty against the exact common nonzero reference difference.

headline_comparisons.target: The three named contractions validate against their common analytic references while the centered spatial covariance traces validate against distinct references.
headline_comparisons.unpaired_confirmation: Recompute the three equal-contraction differences and the centered-variance separating difference on distinct smaller streams with independent-sample uncertainty.

resource_estimate.position_bootstrap_analyses: 7 main direct, 1 main paired H4 centered contrast, and 1 unpaired H4 centered contrast; every replicate recomputes three levels.
resource_estimate.peak_memory_rule: Write bounded per-protocol summaries, retain position features only where required, and bootstrap at batch size eight; fail before the sentinel if arithmetic or resource floors differ.
resource_estimate.resource_scope: Prospective arithmetic from fixed counts, shapes, and caps only; no S-071 or S-072 stochastic values are used.

comparison_rules.symmetry_zero: Use the registered parent-moment scale and disable the relative term.
comparison_rules.derived_trace_scale_departure: For a preregistered trace of a raw matrix, use the sum of the registered diagonal component scales; this departure is fixed before results.
comparison_rules.matched_richardson_difference_se: sample_sd(primary_Richardson_unit-secondary_Richardson_unit)/sqrt(N), or a matched whole-conditional-trajectory bootstrap for nonlinear centered statistics
comparison_rules.aggregate: Contradicted if any required central comparison is contradicted; otherwise unresolved if any required comparison, unpaired confirmation, provenance check, or discretization check is unresolved; validated only if every required item validates.

fail_closed_execution.source_state: Production requires a clean committed execution tree, a marker-bound reviewed source commit, no manifest-path difference between reviewed source and execution HEAD, and the complete canonical-LF source manifest and digest.
fail_closed_execution.attempt_rule: After deterministic gates and resource preflight, create and fsync the sentinel exclusively as the final operation before the first RNG construction. Never remove or replace it.
stop_before_any_run_when: V-072 exact PASS marker absent, duplicated, malformed, quoted, fenced, REVISE, or hash-mismatched
plan, complete source manifest, reviewed source commit, or runtime dependency lock differs
any S-071 path is opened by production
stop_during_or_after_run_when: a gating comparison or adequacy check is unresolved
a reset, conditional-moment, total-variance, or seed-domain invariant fails
a count, seed, window, step, cap, tier, scale, margin, estimand, or tolerance differs
a polling, top-up, retry, alternate output, or second final evaluation is attempted

commands.current_stage_prohibition: Do not run the production command or any stochastic kernel call during S-072 or V-072.

provenance_required_in_result: reviewed source commit, clean execution commit, and complete source manifest
fresh explicit RNG tuples and S-071 disjointness proof
parameters, protocol, conditional-unit counts, and all three steps
interval construction, Monte Carlo uncertainty, B_window, and B_disc
evidence tier, unchanged scale/margin, adequacy diagnostic, and classification
